# Incident report: API outage, July 18

## Summary

Between 14:05 and 14:47 UTC, roughly 30% of API requests failed with 503 errors. The cause was a misconfigured load balancer rule that was deployed as part of a routine change.

## Impact

Customers on the EU cluster were effected. No data was lost.

## Follow-up

- Add a staging check for load balancer rules.
- Update the the change review template.
